item.itunes:author: 碎碎念工坊
item.itunes:summary:

值得閱讀的理由

  • 完整梳理《勝利女神：妮姬》週年慶活動與兩篇番外故事的連貫脈絡，讓玩家一次讀懂小美人魚「賽蓮」與三位量產型妮姬的深刻牽絆。
  • 深入剖析本次週年慶活動在角色塑造、敘事降智與劇情結構上的爭議點與優缺點。
  • 解析最終戰役細節與救援計畫，帶領讀者體驗難得的歡樂圓滿結局（Happy Ending）與高規格動畫演出。

摘要

活動評價兩極與前置脈絡解析

作者指出，期待已久的小美人魚賽蓮終於在週年慶典中登場，然而本次活動劇情在玩家間褒貶不一。主要原因在於劇情中出現過多降智的「哈基仙人」環節、言靈第一印象不佳，以及活動過度依賴主線難以完全討喜。作者強烈建議必須結合第二十四章後的無頭番外篇與第零章墜落番外篇一同品鑑，才能真正理解整個故事的核心魅力。

番外篇背後的三位苦命妮姬故事

作者回顧了三位關鍵角色的身世背景：第一位是被舒恩的私人管家智恩擅自植入萊徹異肢導致生不如死的尤妮；第二位是因掉入液態金屬「黑水」而容貌大變、被賽蓮救起並相處了一個月的利維（LEV-20765）；第三位則是資質平庸、在韓社飽受欺凌且面臨銷毀命運的苦命妮姬茉莉。茉莉受智恩誘騙，被迫攜帶啟動器跟隨米哈拉與尤妮，成為誘發尤妮暴走的棋子。

水晶地底激戰與饕餮吞噬危機

方舟為配合開闢水晶地區研發了A.A.柱，卻在測試時遭特殊個體萊徹饕餮一口吞下，連同地面的米哈拉、尤妮與茉莉也被捲入其中。幸運的是，早已受困於饕餮喉嚨內的賽蓮將她們救至自己的「泡泡島」上。然而賽蓮因過度透支言靈能力而虛弱，隨後暴走裝置被觸發，尤妮陷入瘋狂，饕餮也鎖定A.A.柱展開攻擊。賽蓮在危急時刻轉化胃液能量將三人送出體外，自己卻因無法脫身而陷入絕境。

茉莉的救贖行動與圓滿落幕

回到方舟的茉莉感念賽蓮的善意，決心展開救援。她透過米哈拉獲得的水晶，趁著米哈拉自虐引誘饕餮張嘴時躍入其喉中，將水晶扎入饕餮核心引發爆炸，成功炸開喉嚨救出眾人。故事尾聲，灰姑娘與格拉維在泡泡指引下找到了賽蓮，迎來了珍貴的Happy Ending。作者總結，雖然活動有冗長瑕疵，但豐富的資源、良心的休閒小遊戲與賽蓮頂級的美術表現，依然讓這次活動瑕不掩瑜。

item.title: 这战棋玩着不烧心！独立游戏新作《ROLL一下勇士》可以给到夯！
item.itunes:title: 这战棋玩着不烧心！独立游戏新作《ROLL一下勇士》可以给到夯！
item.itunes:author: 碎碎念工坊
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NU9HYpxcbqA

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解《骰子戰士》如何以簡單易懂的回合制戰鬥，結合骰子符文創造豐富策略。
  • 掌握角色職業、技能、升級與裝備等養成要素，認識隊伍配置的重要性。
  • 看見遊戲的隨機地圖與 Roguelike 設計如何帶來不斷變化的遊玩體驗。

摘要

小巧遊戲帶來新鮮感

在高預算遊戲接連推出、玩法卻容易讓人感到公式化的當下，作者介紹了獨立團隊 Guolu Studio 推出的試玩版《骰子戰士》。遊戲名稱已點出核心玩法：玩家帶領一隊戰士，以回合制策略迎戰敵人，並透過骰子結果左右戰局。地圖採格狀設計，玩家要選擇前進路線，途中會遇到敵人、獎勵、商店與功能格；每張地圖末端則有具特殊能力的頭目。試玩版若挑戰失敗，必須回到第一關重新開始。

隊伍職業與骰子符文

戰鬥開始前，玩家需安排隊伍陣形。目前有五種職業：擅長高傷害近戰的士兵、防禦力強的守衛、負責遠程攻擊的獵人、專精魔法與支援的學徒，以及通過第一章後解鎖的牧師。戰鬥流程直觀，玩家先使用技能，接著由敵人行動；但每回合開始前，隊伍必須先擲骰，決定技能能否施展。骰子以劍、盾、法杖、星星四種符文取代一般點數，各角色骰子的符文種類、比例與數值皆有隨機性，並共同組成全隊可用的符文點數。

調整符文，承擔擲骰風險

不同技能需要不同數量與種類的符文。角色成長後，強力技能所需符文也會增加，因此玩家得依隊伍需求調整符文比例：缺少特定符文時，可更換角色；取得升級勳章後，則可選擇提升指定符文點數。每回合戰鬥前只有兩次擲骰機會，玩家必須決定接受眼前結果，還是再冒險重擲，承受結果可能變差的風險。這套骰子系統讓每次交戰都多了不確定性，也要求玩家兼顧隊伍構成與技能需求。

技能順序與戰鬥判斷

遊戲的策略不只在擲骰。部分技能屬於自動技能，只要符文條件符合，就會在戰鬥開始前觸發，可能帶來先制攻擊或增益效果。面對具有護甲的敵人時，作者提醒可優先使用魔法攻擊削弱防禦，否則其他攻擊可能無法有效造成傷害。非自動技能的施放順序則由玩家決定，但並非所有技能都必須使用；閱讀敵方情報、依情勢選擇行動，才能避免錯誤出招反而陷入劣勢。

角色成長與裝備選擇

角色會隨戰鬥經驗提升等級，並能透過職業晉升獲得更高屬性，例如新兵可成為神射手，守衛則可晉升為方陣士兵。試玩版目前最多可晉升三次，開發者表示正式版預計增加至五次。每次升級會出現隨機成長選項，除了技能、屬性與增益效果，也可能改變符文配置；若重要技能難以觸發，重新分配符文便是值得考慮的方向。玩家還能以戰鬥或地圖中取得的金幣購買裝備，不過裝備有職業限制，並非所有角色都能使用同一類物品。

每次冒險都有變數

作者認為，《骰子戰士》以容易上手的基本規則，包裹了豐富的Roguelike 隨機性：可取得的角色、角色成長與技能、地圖上的敵人和獎勵，以及骰子產生的技能組合，都可能隨每次遊玩而改變。即使反覆挑戰，玩家仍得不斷適應新的狀況。作者因此看好它成為休閒獨立遊戲中的黑馬，也推薦喜愛簡單規則、卻能從中發掘多變策略的玩家，體驗步步皆有驚喜的冒險。

================================================

Although there have been many high-budget, polished games released this year, the constant barrage of formulaic content has left many players feeling a sense of aesthetic fatigue. If you're looking for a change of pace —something compact, simple to play, yet full of personality and unique charm—then "Dice Warrior," recently released as a demo by the independent developer Guolu Studio, might just be the unassuming yet delightful surprise you're looking for. If you're wondering what "Dice Warrior" is all about, the.

title actually tells you everything you need to know. You command a team of warriors to defeat enemies through turn-based strategy, where the dice rolls of various forms are the key factor in determining the course of battle. The game uses a grid-based system where players must choose their path and direction on the map. Beyond enemies, the maps are also populated with randomly distributed rewards, shops, and other functional tiles. At the end of each map, there is a Boss with special abilities that must be defeated to clear that stage. However, based on the current demo version, if a player fails a challenge, they are sent all the way back to the first level to.

start over. The basic game design is very straightforward; before battle, you need to arrange the formation of your team's characters. There are currently five character classes: the high-damage melee "Soldier," the highly defensive "Guard," the ranged "Hunter," the magic and support-focused " Apprentice," and the "Priest," who is unlocked after clearing the first chapter. Basic attacks are split into melee and ranged types; as the name implies, melee attacks cannot strike enemies in the back row, and the combat style is similar to most turn-based games. We finish our round of skill.

actions, and then the enemy takes their turn, making it very easy to understand and pick up. Yet, behind this simple, traditional gameplay lies the massive influence of a core dice system. Before every round of combat, players must first roll the dice to determine the preparation phase for available skills. However, these aren't the standard one-to-six-sided dice we play with; they use runes as symbols, with four types: sword, shield, staff, and star. Every character has their own dice; which runes a character rolls, the distribution ratios, and the specific point values are all randomly determined. Since different skills.

require different types and quantities of runes to activate, the results rolled by all characters are combined to create the team's total pool of rune points. Of course, rolling a combination that satisfies the activation conditions for all skills of every team member is ideal. However, as characters grow, many more powerful skills will appear that require more runes, making it increasingly difficult to roll the desired results in actual combat. This requires you to carefully adjust your rune ratios. When you lack certain runes, consider swapping in different characters. When obtaining upgrade medals, choose those that increase specific rune points based on.

your team's needs; this will help build a more perfect rune ratio and increase the probability of rolling ideal outcomes. Crucially, you only have two chances to roll before each round of combat. You must judge whether the currently triggered skills are what you need. Do you settle for the current result, or do you gamble one more time, risking a worse outcome? This adds an exciting layer of uncertainty to every battle. One thing to pay special attention to: although the combat may seem simple, there is actually a great deal of strategy involved in how you use your skills. First, some skills are.

automatic. They cannot be manually activated; as long as the required runes are rolled, they will trigger automatically before the battle begins. These might be preemptive strikes or supportive buff effects. Second, due to the armor mechanic, some enemies will absorb damage with their armor value at the start of each round. When facing enemies with high armor, prioritize using magic-based attacks to break their defense first; otherwise, some attacks may fail to penetrate, effectively wasting your turn. Third, you can freely decide the order of non-automatic skills. While the sequence is important, remember that.

not every available skill must be used. Sometimes you should pay attention to enemy intel, as using the wrong skill in certain situations could actually put you at a disadvantage. Also, don't forget that all characters in your team will level up as they accumulate combat experience. Classes can evolve through promotion, which changes their titles —for example, a Recruit promotes to a Sharpshooter, and a Guard promotes to a Phalanx Soldier—providing significant stat improvements. The current version allows characters up to three class advancements. According to the developers, the official release will.

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解熱門手遊《勝利女神：妮姬》人氣迷因「Doro（Dolla）」從非官方二創轉向官方商標註冊的法律轉變。
  • 探討墨西哥實體小店將網路迷因商業化後，面臨版權歸屬與官方拒絕授權時的公關危機與處理智慧。
  • 解析遊戲官方在嚴格保護智慧財產權的同時，如何與社群創作者達成溫和溝通與「軟著陸」的平衡範例。

摘要

迷因爆紅與墨西哥玉米店的誕生

作者指出，在《勝利女神：妮姬》社群中，Dolla（Doro）迷因擁有極高的傳播度與代表性，甚至在官方收購前就已成為實質上的吉祥物。一對身為死忠玩家的墨西哥夫妻自2024年底起，將該形象融入自己的墨西哥玉米小吃店並販售周邊，迅速在拉丁美洲社群累積破萬追蹤。然而，這家小店繁榮發展的基礎，始終並非屬於他們自己的智慧財產權。

商標收購與商業授權遭拒的衝擊

2025年，遊戲開發商Shift Up向原作者購買專利並正式註冊商標，使原本處於灰色地帶的二創營利轉為具體的侵權風險。玉米店在同年9月嘗試與官方展開授權談判，儘管官方曾給予創作者獎項，最終仍拒絕了商業化授權請求。店家隨後發表聲明宣布停止使用該形象、刪除相關商業內容並展開新計畫，該告別貼文在社群引發超過200萬次瀏覽與激烈的正反論戰。

摘要

經典回歸：在寫實浪潮下誕生的奇幻篇章

作者回顧了初代 PlayStation 平台的 JRPG 黃金時代。在《最終幻想VII》與《最終幻想VIII》引領電影化與寫實風格的浪潮中，史克威爾（Square）決定在 PS1 平台的成熟期推出最後一款系列正傳作品《最終幻想IX》。由「最終幻想之父」坂口博信主導，本作刻意摒棄寫實比例，回歸早期任天堂時代的經典奇幻童話風格，以「生命」為核心主題，由植松伸夫配樂、天野喜孝操刀角色設計，打造出一個洋溢生活感與純真夢想的世界。

蓋亞世界觀與深化的戰鬥成長系統

故事舞台設定於名為蓋亞的世界，多數文明聚居於被神祕毒霧籠罩但富含能源的霧之大陸。遊戲回歸了系列經典的四人組隊戰鬥模式，並設計了透過裝備獲取並永久習得的能力點數（AP）系統。戰鬥系統延續了標誌性的即時戰鬥（ATB）機制，並由受傷累積發動的幻化（Trance）系統取代傳統極限技，賦予角色全新姿態與強大戰術價值。

豐富趣味小遊戲與傳奇經典的現代傳承

除了厚重的冒險故事，遊戲還融入了深度極高的卡牌遊戲「九宮幻卡」（Tetra Master）以及獲取頂級裝備必備的陸行鳥尋寶等支線要素。配樂方面，傳奇作曲家植松伸夫創作出破紀錄的 152 首曲目，並將其視為個人生涯最愛的集大成之作。本作推出後贏得各大媒體的高度讚譽與玩家熱烈票選認可；隨後推出的現代高畫質重製版本更加載了倍速模式與自動存檔功能，讓新世代玩家能更輕鬆地重溫這部傳奇傑作。

The Final Fantasy series defined. a new direction for game production. with its massive blockbusters,. characterized by grand environments,. realistic character proportions, and. extensive story cinematics. Traditional. chibi-style designs were dismissed as. rudimentary. Sakaguchi, known as the "Father of. Final Fantasy," wasn't satisfied with.

his past successes and hoped to achieve. even greater breakthroughs on the PS2. platform. With the story-driven Final. Fantasy X and the multiplayer-focused. Final Fantasy XI being developed. simultaneously, the new hardware. platform required adjustment. This. would lead to a long gap after the 1999. release of Final Fantasy VIII, so. Square decided to launch one last title. on the mature PS1 platform. At the 2000. Square Millennium event, the three. major titles Final Fantasy IX, X, and. Hawaii office, with each map area. assigned to a different lead. responsible for its events and dialogue. . Uematsu as composer. This title pays. tribute to the series 'earlier works,. recapturing the essence of the. franchise. Continent remains the most prosperous. in Gaia. While the other three. continents are free of Mist, they are. difficult to reach by airship, leaving. them largely desolate. The Outer. Continent to the north is arid and. connected to the Mist Continent by a. fossilized path. Only a few dwarves. reside there. The Lost Continent in the. northwest is almost entirely covered in. ice, rumored to contain islands and. volcanoes that connect to other worlds.

When the protagonist. passes an interactive point, a question. mark or exclamation mark appears,. allowing for interaction. Players. eventually unlock Chocobos, ships, and. other transport. In the later stages of. the game, once the airship is obtained,. players can freely travel between. previously unlocked locations on the. world map. In the game, the player's. party earns experience points and. levels up by defeating enemies. Character abilities require specific. equipment to be used; meanwhile,. players earn ability points, and after. reaching a certain threshold, the skill. is learned permanently and can be used. without the item. You can learn skills. faster by equipping items that allow. for multi-key skill learning. Some. skills can also be enhanced using. specific items. In addition, some. skills are exclusive to certain. characters. Unlike the previous two. entries, the seventh and eighth, which. featured a three-person party, this. game returns to the classic four-person. party. The protagonist, who stays in. your party for most of the game, has a. very useful Steal skill; many valuable. items are first obtained by stealing. from bosses rather than buying them.

from merchants. It is worth noting that. Final Fantasy allows for two-player. co-op control during battles. However,. this feature is not mentioned in the. game's manual. The standard player. count for PlayStation games of that era. was also one. Skills are divided into. active and passive categories; active. skills include magic, weapon specials,. and summons, while passive skills. provide status buffs, such as. resistance boosts or extra damage. against specific enemies. There is a. limit to how many support skills you. can equip, depending on your slot count. ; each skill occupies a certain number. of slots, and you gain more slots by. leveling up. Starting with Final. Fantasy IV, the Active Time Battle (ATB. ) system became a series staple; when a. character's ATB gauge fills, they can. execute commands while enemies act in. real-time. Novice players can choose " Wait" mode, which freezes enemies while. you select magic or items in the menu,. giving you more time to think. Another. unique system is Trance, inherited from. the Limit Break system introduced in. Final Fantasy VII. Unlike previous. games where you trigger specials, here,. characters fill a gauge by taking. damage; once full, they automatically. enter Trance, changing their appearance. and enabling new skills. You can. strategically set skills to achieve. twice the output with half the effort. during this state. Beyond the main. story, Final Fantasy IX features rich. side quests and mini-games, the two. most important of which are: First is.

the card game known as Tetra Master. Players start with a beginner deck and. tutorial, then build their collection. by challenging NPCs or finding rare. cards dropped by enemies, which is very. rewarding. Tetra Master was later spun. off into an online game, but that's a. story for another time. The other is. Chocobo Hot and Cold, where players can. dig for random treasures using maps. after reaching the Chocobo Forest. There are multiple digging spots across. the world, and by digging more often,. you can level up your Chocobo to find. even better treasures. Some ultimate. equipment in the game can only be. obtained through Chocobo treasure. hunting, which is a great help for. clearing the game smoothly. The game's. background music was entirely composed. by Nobuo Uematsu, reaching an. unprecedented 152 tracks, so much so. that the official 4-CD original. soundtrack only included 110, omitting. the music from the cutscenes. The. separately released PLUS CD later. supplemented this content. Uematsu. stated in an interview that the music. and the game itself were his favorites. among all his projects. The theme song. "Eyes on Me," sung by renowned singer. Faye Wong, has both Japanese and. English versions for different regions,. and all the music is now available on. Apple Music. After its release, the. game received widespread acclaim, with. Famitsu giving it a 38/40 Platinum Hall. of Fame rating and IGN a 9.2/10. Global. sales reached 5.3 million units, with. 2.78 million in Japan alone. Critics.

primarily praised the game's nostalgic. elements, storytelling, and musical. score. Hironobu Sakaguchi considered. this game his favorite in the series. At the PlayStation Awards held in June. 2001, the game won awards for Best. Graphics, Best Scenario, Best Character. , and Best Music. These were all voted. for by a large number of players, fully. demonstrating their recognition of such. an excellent work. On February 9, 2016,. a remastered version of Final Fantasy. VIII was released on mobile, featuring. enhanced graphics and completely. redesigned menus, battle interfaces,. and dialogue windows. Players can. choose to skip animations, and there is. even a 2x speed mode to quicken the. pace; achievements and auto-save also. make it much more accessible for. newcomers. Building on this version, it. was subsequently released on a wide. range of platforms including Steam,. Switch, PS4, and Xbox One. Final. Fantasy VIII can be said to be a. perfect rebirth of the series' original. design philosophy on advanced hardware. Many ideas in the past were limited by. console performance and cartridge. capacity, but in the PS era, through. polygon technology and high-capacity. discs, the fantasy world in the. designers 'minds was finally realized. If you want to experience the purest. JRPG, this game is a must-play; this. most authentic Final Fantasy will not. disappoint you. If you’ve been. playing the modern "Big Three" recently. , why not switch things up? Join us for. a retro journey, experience the charm.

of old games, spread gaming culture,. and share in the ninth art. At the end. of the video, please like, follow, and. support us. Your support is our. motivation for updates. Thank you for. watching, and see you in the next one.

作者回顧了初代 PlayStation 平台的 JRPG 黃金時代。在《最終幻想VII》與《最終幻想VIII》引領電影化與寫實風格的浪潮中，史克威爾（Square）決定在 PS1 平台的成熟期推出最後一款系列正傳作品《最終幻想IX》。由「最終幻想之父」坂口博信主導，本作刻意摒棄寫實比例，回歸早期任天堂時代的經典奇幻童話風格，以「生命」為核心主題，由植松伸夫配樂、天野喜孝操刀角色設計，打造出一個洋溢生活感與純真夢想的世界。

蓋亞世界觀與深化的戰鬥成長系統

故事舞台設定於名為蓋亞的世界，多數文明聚居於被神祕毒霧籠罩但富含能源的霧之大陸。遊戲回歸了系列經典的四人組隊戰鬥模式，並設計了透過裝備獲取並永久習得的能力點數（AP）系統。戰鬥系統延續了標誌性的即時戰鬥（ATB）機制，並由受傷累積發動的幻化（Trance）系統取代傳統極限技，賦予角色全新姿態與強大戰術價值。

豐富趣味小遊戲與傳奇經典的現代傳承

除了厚重的冒險故事，遊戲還融入了深度極高的卡牌遊戲「九宮幻卡」（Tetra Master）以及獲取頂級裝備必備的陸行鳥尋寶等支線要素。配樂方面，傳奇作曲家植松伸夫創作出破紀錄的 152 首曲目，並將其視為個人生涯最愛的集大成之作。本作推出後贏得各大媒體的高度讚譽與玩家熱烈票選認可；隨後推出的現代高畫質重製版本更加載了倍速模式與自動存檔功能，讓新世代玩家能更輕鬆地重溫這部傳奇傑作。
